signals_in_scope.name: Regional Manufacturing Activity (Philly Fed)

source.name: Philadelphia Fed Manufacturing Business Outlook Survey (via FRED GACDFSA066MSFRBPHI)

signals_in_scope.existing_summary: Factories around Philadelphia sounded a little gloomy last month — but that's one region, not the whole country. The national factory gauge is more upbeat right now, and the gap between the two is the part worth watching.

weekly_connection_in_scope.title: Two economies, same week
weekly_connection_in_scope.observation: People feel about as bad about the economy as they have in a decade, and they expect prices to keep rising. At the same time, the major AI companies keep cutting what they charge — top model prices are down about 60% over six months — and new, more capable models keep arriving every few weeks.
